# Potential Asset Rotations: Deep Dive Analysis

Report 142 | Published 2024-08-04 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2024-8-4/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/142.json)

Liquidity, recession risk, and foreign-asset rotation.

The article explicitly withholds endorsement of quoted rate-equivalence estimates and admits an earlier rotation miss. Its strongest verified points are ETF outflows, employment revision risk, continued privacy enforcement, and 2025 Fed purchases. Broad recession and rotation language is flexible; positive GDP and uneven foreign returns resist an uncomplicated win. Source launch-date and ratio-scale errors are preserved as editorial limitations.

**Coverage:** All text and image labels read. Includes issuance mechanics, labor/recession thesis, politics/privacy, ETF flows, Ethereum positioning, capital flows, refinancing, valuation rotation and gold. Quoted Miran/Roubini numerical equivalents explicitly disclaimed by author, so not counted as her forecasts. Historical 2019 error acknowledged, not a new call.
